info.title: fal/h3-max
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "fal/h3-max", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for the MiniMax H3 Max text-to-video model (minimax/h3-max/text-to-video): generate a video from a text prompt.

example.prompt: a red fox running through a snowy forest

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds.

prompt_expansion_mode.description: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation: balanced or quality.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video: 480P or 768P.

seed.description: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted.

sync_mode.description: Return the generated video as base64 instead of a CDN URL.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
